logs.title: Third try
logs.text:
First try, the paint ran. Second try, the wind took the tin. Third try, I held it still with my knees and both hands and it came out straight.
I asked her at the airlock. She said yes before I finished the question.
I am painting this from outside, in a suit, in the cold, and I have never been warmer.

logs.title: Honesty box, last page
logs.text:
Took one cell. Left two. Do the maths, I'm trying.
Took the tape. Left a better tape.
Took nothing. Wanted to say I was here.
I MEANT TO COME BACK. (Underneath: YOU DID.)

logs.title: Marginalia
logs.text:
Hold My Fuel: sorry about the noise.
Second Hand: thanks for the weld.
Blue Tuesday: we were here and we're all right.
Slow Boat: we'll be a while. Save us a plate.
